title: ERPNext 15 sales order, Standard print format, Modern print style, HTML letter head, A4, 2 pages
notes: Sales Order SAL-ORD-2026-00001, submitted, dated 2026-10-19, delivery date 2026-11-16, customer Hôtel-Restaurant Le Cèdre, customer PO CEDRE-2026-112 of 2026-10-16, 6 lines (CER-ASS-27 60 x 24.50, CER-ASS-21 60 x 18.00, CER-ASC-23 40 x 21.00, CER-TAS-25 80 x 12.80, CER-PLT-40 12 x 48.00, CER-RAM-09 120 x 7.20), net 5 854.00 EUR, VAT 20 % 1 170.80, total 7 024.80, terms "Conditions générales de vente", company address block. Print Settings: print style Modern, PDF page size A4; other settings as the defaults (font Default, Repeat Header and Footer on, Compact Item Print off, with letter head). Letter Head Atelier Kiln (the default one of `erpnext15-sales-invoice`): HTML header (logo `/files/atelier-kiln-logo.png` and company address) and HTML footer (legal mentions, bank details). Captured from Frappe 15.124.0 (commit f1cf50cf9bbc) + ERPNext 15.124.1 (commit 4e0dce9ea8d3), printed through HTTP /api/method/frappe.utils.print_format.download_pdf with a logged-in session, as the print view's PDF button does. Frappe (pdfkit 1.0.0) pipes the page on stdin and reads the PDF from stdout: `-` `-` at the end; the output `-` is replaced by {out}. Frappe passed `--cookie-jar /tmp/<random>.jar` (session cookie sid); that pair is removed. /tmp/frappe-pdf-<random>.html header and footer files became input/header.html and input/footer.html. No margin-top or margin-bottom is passed: the header and footer heights decide the margins. The footer page inlines the whole print CSS; the header page links it. JavaScript is disabled for the page but the footer's subst() still fills the page numbers. Origin http://127.0.0.1:8000 rewritten to http://127.0.0.1:8765 in input/page.html, input/header.html (no www/ file contained it). www lists the entry's own files (if any) then corpus/_shared/erpnext15/www (print CSS print.bundle.7DKZWKDD.css, same content as H34JAH53 of the first two ERPNext entries but for three comments, and the Atelier Kiln logo). httpHeaders are the Cache-Control values the Frappe server sent. The print CSS has no @font-face: the text relies on fonts installed on the machine. ERPNext parts are GPL-3.0; Frappe parts are MIT; the print CSS also bundles Bootstrap 3.3.1, normalize.css and HTML5 Boilerplate (MIT) and Quill 2.0.3 CSS (BSD-3-Clause); letter heads, images and business data were written for the corpus. See SOURCE.md.
